title: The Short-term Verbal Memory Endophenotype for Developmental Language Disorder Language Disorder
official: The Short-term Verbal Memory Endophenotype for Developmental Language Disorder
summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to determine how memory and attention affect the ability of children with developmental language disorder (DLD) to learn and use new vocabulary.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Has DLD or typical language development

Exclusion Criteria

* Has not been exposed to English since birth
* Has other neurodevelopmental or sensory condition that could explain the language problem (e.g., intellectual disability, autism, hearing loss).
